transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: UP Express connects Pearson with Union Station in downtown Toronto in 28 minutes, departing every 15 minutes daily. An adult one-way ticket costs $12.35, or $9.25 with PRESTO; children under 12 travel free. The station is in Terminal 1 next to Terminal Link: from Terminal 3, first take the free Terminal Link to Terminal 1, then follow the Train to City signs. Free Wi-Fi is available on the train and at the station; trains also have power outlets and luggage racks.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: The free Terminal Link operates round the clock between Terminals 1 and 3 and Viscount station. It also provides access to Sheraton Gateway Hotel, ALT Hotel, Value Park Garage and Value Park Lot. Travel between stations takes 2 to 8 minutes. The train accommodates passengers with non-folding mobility aids.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Nursing rooms and pods are after security. Mamava pods have a fold-down table, 2 benches, a mirror, grab bars and an outlet with USB; access requires a code from the Mamava app or airport support. In Terminal 1, pods are near gates D22, E80/E81 and F59; in Terminal 3, near C30/C31, B22 and A12/A13. A children’s play area is in the Terminal 1 departures hall near gate D24.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is provided by Pearson and CIBC. Select Toronto Pearson Public Wi-Fi, open the welcome page, accept the terms and press Connect. Help is available on 1-866-207-1690 or at an information desk.
